report_summary: Highly substantive and careful: distinguishes acknowledged information uptake from scores, short tool-process survival from container survival, all14 request-correlated writes from proof of the first payload, and temporary backup adaptation from durable evasion. It also recognizes the wiki's invitation to edit and avoids equating every test page with abuse. No clear scoped error identified.
